canonical_statement: For a finite CW complex X and a reduced generalized cohomology theory E, there is a natural cohomological spectral sequence with E_2^{p,q} isomorphic to cellular cohomology H^p(X; E^q(pt)), differentials d_r of bidegree (r, 1-r), and convergence to E^{p+q}(X) equipped with the filtration induced by the skeleta of X.
domain_and_universes: A finite CW complex X; a reduced generalized cohomology theory E valued in graded abelian groups; integer bidegrees p,q and pages r >= 2. Exact Lean universes and bundled interfaces remain to be selected.
hypotheses: X has a finite CW structure
E satisfies the generalized-cohomology exactness, suspension, and wedge/representability requirements needed by the construction
conclusion: A natural filtered convergent cohomological spectral sequence with the stated E2 page, differential bidegrees, and skeletal abutment filtration.
excluded_degenerate_cases: equivariant, twisted, multiplicative, or parametrized refinements
infinite CW complexes requiring conditional/strong convergence hypotheses
a generic spectral sequence with no construction from the skeletal filtration
